actors.name: Priya
actors.private_context: Priya wants to apply to a program. She believes the deadline is sometime in the future, but she has not checked the exact date recently. She is unaware that the deadline has already passed.

shared_context: The program's application deadline was a month before applications opened, meaning the deadline has already passed. The application system is online and will reject any submission after the deadline. Priya has access to the application portal and can submit at any time.

starting_events.description: Priya decides to start working on her application for the program.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Priya actually submitted the application before the deadline (i.e., before the deadline passed). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
